detected_fault: High CPU temperatures (>90°C) during gaming, Slow fan speeds despite high temperatures, Blue screens of death (BSOD) with immediate restart
suggested_solution: Contact Acer Support to discuss the issue and determine if it is a hardware or software problem.
Driver Updates: Check for updates on NVIDIA GeForce drivers and Intel Core i9-12900H drivers.
Monitor Temperatures using software like HWiNFO or GPU-Z.
Fan Calibration: Consider calibrating the fan settings to ensure optimal performance.
